## About
Jackpot Auto Dismantling serves the Los Angeles area with quality used parts. You can search what we have online before you make the trip, so you know what you're coming in for.
Customers tell us they like how we do business: straight talk, fair prices, and no time wasted. One reviewer put it simply: the price online is the price you get at the shop.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used auto parts for drivers and mechanics around Los Angeles.
- Inventory search: Look up what we have in stock, search by image, or use multi-part search.

## FAQ
Q: Can I check if you have a part before I come in?
A: Yes. Our website has an inventory search. One reviewer found their part online and came in the same day to buy it.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and on Saturday, and closed Sunday. Give us a call to confirm Saturday hours before you come in.

Q: Is the price online the same as in the shop?
A: One reviewer said the price they saw online was the price they paid at the shop.
